{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mrlssi half-hitch''', developed by the [[Mrlssi]], was one of the [[Twelve Intermediate Knots]]. [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] once taught [[Pax Chizzik]] this knot when he was having problems in [[Master]] [[Bear (Jedi)|Bear's]] Climbing and Ropework class.<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
